description: The storage manager resolves a named disk from a configuration object into a usable storage backend. Resolution fails fast with a normalized error when the configuration is incomplete or references an unknown backend kind. The request supplies the manager configuration and asks the manager to resolve a disk, and the normalized failure is reported.

cases.expected_output:
error=invalid_config
code=E_INVALID_CONFIG
status=500
detail=Make sure to define config for main disk

error=invalid_config
code=E_INVALID_CONFIG
status=500
detail=Make sure to define driver for store disk

error=driver_not_supported
status=400
driver=azure
detail=Driver azure is not supported
